parsed.summary: The PR changes the 'dim' argument to 'coord' in the DataArray.integrate method to align with the Dataset API. The change is minimal and does not introduce any apparent issues.

issues.description: This change introduces an API/compatibility break by altering the argument name from 'dim' to 'coord' in the DataArray.integrate method. This could potentially break existing code that relies on the current API.
